title.en: Confusability strong powers, C7 bounds, and the C2 collapse clique

statement.en: InterfaceBits proves CC2 factor-2 sandwiches (n > 0 log2 gap <= 1/n), triangle-free lifts, C7/C7^2/C7^3 bounds, and joins Becoming.OplaxHistory.C2RelativeLossWitness.c2_n_step_collapse (in Becoming/RelSpan.lean) on 2^n finite K2 representatives.

laws.en: General strong-product laws give indep_strongProd, clique_strongProd, coloring_strongProd, k3free_strongProd, indep_strongProd_K2, cc2_is_two_colorable, and cc_sandwich (with 0..1/n normalized log2 gap on nonempty finite carriers for n > 0).

Cyclic double counting (cyclic_translate_bound, c7_indep_adjacent_bound, c7Pow_k3free_card_bound) with small reflected decide witnesses establishes C7 (alpha=3, chi=3, chiCC2<=2, chiK3Free=1), C7^2 (alpha=10, chi=5, chiCC2<=4, chiK3Free=3), C7^3 (30<=alpha<=35, chiK3Free=5), and log2 chi(C7^n)/n <= (1/2)log2 5 + log2 3 / n (for n > 0).

Finite restriction rep maps each Fin (powTwo n) vertex injectively into a 2^n-element K2 strong-power clique sharing the same Becoming.OplaxHistory.C2RelativeLossWitness.c2ChainChi collapsed value inside the infinite unrestricted fiber over Nat -> Bool (c2_collapse_clique).

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 Mathlib periphery module InterfaceBits importing core Becoming.RelSpan under [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext] with zero native_decide, zero private/opaque source declarations, zero n=3,4 brute-force search, and environment-wide audit of all 156 module constants.
Confusability R includes equality reflexively and assumes symmetric pairwise confusability rather than an arbitrary channel output hypergraph.

does_not_show.en: The module establishes only 30 <= alpha(C7^3) <= 35 locally; published packing alpha(C7^3) = 33 and chi(C7^3) >= 11 stand external in the literature.
c7Sq_chiCC2_le proves chiCC2(C7^2) <= 4 via a concrete witness; 3-class UNSAT evidence belongs to external probe records rather than Lean.

Triangle-free classes give list size <= 2 when common outputs form triangles; pairwise confusability permits 3 distinct outputs, so the converse needs every relevant triangle to admit a common output (Rule 2).

detail.en: c7Sq_chi_eq drops chi(C7^2) = 5 strictly below 3^2 = 9 while c7Sq_chiCC2_le achieves 4 CC2 classes; c2_collapse_clique exhibits 2^n distinguishable finite representatives inside one C2 collapsed fiber.
